  123. /** Surge multipliers */

  125. export const RUSH_HOUR_SURGE = 1.2;
  126. export const WEEKEND_NIGHT_SURGE = 1.3;

  135. // ─── Haversine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  136.  
  137. export function haversine(
  138. lat1: number,
  139. lon1: number,
  140. lat2: number,
  141. lon2: number
  142. ): number {
  143. const R = 6371;
  144. const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  145. const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  146. const a =
  147. Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
  148. Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
  149. Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
  150. Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
  151. return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  152. }
  153.  
  154. // ─── Duration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  155.  
  156. export function estimateDuration(distanceKm: number): number {
  157. if (distanceKm <= 0) return 0;
  158. return (distanceKm / AVG_CITY_SPEED_KMH) * 60;
  159. }
  160.  
  161. // ─── Base Price Calculation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  162.  
  163. export function calculateUberBasePrice(
  164. distanceKm: number,
  165. durationMin: number
  166. ): number {
  167. return UBER_BASE + UBER_PER_KM * distanceKm + UBER_PER_MIN * durationMin;
  168. }
  169.  
  170. export function calculateDidiBasePrice(
  171. distanceKm: number,
  172. durationMin: number
  173. ): number {
  174. return DIDI_BASE + DIDI_PER_KM * distanceKm + DIDI_PER_MIN * durationMin;
  175. }
  176.  
  177. // ─── Factor Detection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  178.  
  179. export function detectFactors(
  180. now: Date = new Date(),
  181. precipMm: number = 0
  182. ): EstimateFactors {
  183. const timezone = 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires';
  184. const hourStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
  185. timeZone: timezone,
  186. hour: 'numeric',
  187. hour12: false,
  188. }).format(now);
  189. const hour = parseInt(hourStr, 10);
  190. if (isNaN(hour)) {
  191. const utcHour = now.getUTCHours();
  192. return detectFactorsFromHourDay((utcHour - 3 + 24) % 24, now.getUTCDay(), precipMm);
  193. }
  194.  
  195. const dayName = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
  196. timeZone: timezone,
  197. weekday: 'long',
  198. }).format(now);
  199. const dayMap: Record<string, number> = {
  200. Sunday: 0, Monday: 1, Tuesday: 2, Wednesday: 3,
  201. Thursday: 4, Friday: 5, Saturday: 6,
  202. };
  203. const day = dayMap[dayName] ?? now.getDay();
  204. return detectFactorsFromHourDay(hour, day, precipMm);
  205. }
  206.  
  207. function detectFactorsFromHourDay(
  208. hour: number,
  209. day: number,
  210. precipMm: number
  211. ): EstimateFactors {
  212. const weather = precipMm > 0;
  213. const rushHour =
  214. (hour >= 7 && hour < 9) || (hour >= 17 && hour < 19);
  215. const weekendNight =
  216. ((day === 5 || day === 6) && hour >= 22) ||
  217. ((day === 6 || day === 0) && hour < 2);
  218. return { weather, rushHour, weekendNight };
  219. }
  220.  
  221. // ─── Composite Surge Multiplier ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  222.  
  223. export function applySurge(
  224. basePrice: number,
  225. factors: EstimateFactors
  226. ): number {
  227. let price = basePrice;
  228. if (factors.weather) price *= WEATHER_SURGE;
  229. if (factors.rushHour) price *= RUSH_HOUR_SURGE;
  230. if (factors.weekendNight) price *= WEEKEND_NIGHT_SURGE;
  231. return price;
  232. }
  233.  
  234. // ─── Price Breakdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  235.  
  236. export function buildPriceBreakdown(estimate: number): PriceBreakdown {
  237. return {
  238. low: Math.round(estimate * RANGE_LOW * 100) / 100,
  239. high: Math.round(estimate * RANGE_HIGH * 100) / 100,
  240. estimate: Math.round(estimate * 100) / 100,
  241. };
  242. }
  243.  
  244. // ─── Which Is Cheaper? ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  245.  
  246. export function determineCheaper(
  247. uberEstimate: number,
  248. didiEstimate: number
  249. ): "uber" | "didi" | "similar" {
  250. const diff = Math.abs(uberEstimate - didiEstimate);
  251. const avg = (uberEstimate + didiEstimate) / 2;
  252. if (avg > 0 && diff / avg < 0.05) return "similar";
  253. return uberEstimate < didiEstimate ? "uber" : "didi";
  254. }
  255.  
  256. // ─── Advice ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  257.  
  258. export function generateAdvice(factors: EstimateFactors): string {
  259. if (factors.weekendNight) return "Precios normales para el horario";
  260. if (factors.rushHour && !factors.weather) return "Conviene esperar";
  261. if (!factors.rushHour && factors.weather) return "Pedí ahora";
  262. return "Precios normales";
  263. }
  264.  
  265. // ─── Deep Links ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  266.  
  267. export function buildDeepLinks(
  268. originLat: number,
  269. originLon: number,
  270. originName: string,
  271. destLat: number,
  272. destLon: number,
  273. destName: string
  274. ): { uber: string; didi: string } {
  275. const uberLink =
  276. `https://m.uber.com/ul/?action=setPickup` +
  277. `&pickup[latitude]=${originLat}` +
  278. `&pickup[longitude]=${originLon}` +
  279. `&pickup[formatted_address]=${encodeURIComponent(originName)}` +
  280. `&dropoff[latitude]=${destLat}` +
  281. `&dropoff[longitude]=${destLon}` +
  282. `&dropoff[formatted_address]=${encodeURIComponent(destName)}`;
  283.  
  284. const didiLink =
  285. `https://web.didiglobal.com/rider/?action=setPickup` +
  286. `&pickupLat=${originLat}` +
  287. `&pickupLng=${originLon}` +
  288. `&dropoffLat=${destLat}` +
  289. `&dropoffLng=${destLon}`;
  290.  
  291. return { uber: uberLink, didi: didiLink };
  292. }
  293.  
  294. // ─── Confidence Level ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  295.  
  296. export function determineConfidence(
  297. historicalCount: number
  298. ): "high" | "medium" | "low" {
  299. if (historicalCount >= CONFIDENCE_HIGH_THRESHOLD) return "high";
  300. if (historicalCount >= 1) return "medium";
  301. return "low";
  302. }
